components.name: Action Button
components.description: Use when a decision, approval or intervention needs the merchant now.
components.css: .ds-btn-action { height: 36px; padding: 9px 14px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--app-action, #ffd45b); color: var(--app-action-ink, #171714); font: 600 12px/1.25 var(--font-inter, system-ui, sans-serif); transition: filter 150ms ease, transform 100ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-action:hover { filter: brightness(0.95); } .ds-btn-action:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #2457d6); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-action:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Leading non-decision action in the current theme.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 36px; padding: 9px 14px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--app-accent, #ffd45b); color: var(--app-accent-ink, #171714); font: 600 12px/1.25 var(--font-inter, system-ui, sans-serif); transition: filter 150ms ease, transform 100ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(0.96); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #2457d6); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }

components.name: Secondary Button

components.css: .ds-nav { width: 236px; padding: 16px 10px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--app-nav, #17245a); color: var(--app-nav-ink, #fffdf9); font-family: var(--font-inter, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-nav-group { display: block; margin: 0 12px 6px; color: var(--app-nav-muted, rgba(237,239,252,.76)); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; min-height: 36px; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--app-nav-muted, rgba(237,239,252,.76)); font-size: 13px; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-item svg { width: 17px; height: 17px; flex: none; } .ds-nav-item b { margin-left: auto; min-width: 19px; padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--app-action, #ffd45b); color: var(--app-action-ink, #171714); font-size: 10px; text-align: center; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: var(--app-nav-hover, rgba(255,255,255,.07)); color: var(--app-nav-ink, #fffdf9); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #2457d6); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-nav-active { background: var(--app-nav-active, #fffdf9); color: var(--app-nav-active-ink, #171714); font-weight: 600; } .ds-nav-utility { margin-top: 14px; padding-top: 8px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09); border-radius: 0 0 8px 8px; }

components.html:

components.css: .ds-card { display: grid; gap: 12px; padding: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--app-line, rgba(23,23,20,.13)); border-radius: 14px; background: var(--app-surface, #fffdf9); color: var(--app-ink, #171714); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(23,23,20,.04), 0 18px 40px -30px rgba(23,23,20,.32); font-family: var(--font-inter, system-ui, sans-serif); transition: border-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-card:hover { border-color: var(--app-line-strong, rgba(23,23,20,.21)); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(23,23,20,.06), 0 22px 48px -30px rgba(23,23,20,.38); } .ds-card h3, .ds-card p { margin: 0; } .ds-card h3 { margin-top: 3px; font: 600 16px/1.25 var(--font-space-grotesk, system-ui, sans-serif); letter-spacing: -.01em; } .ds-card > p { color: var(--app-muted, #65656f); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-card-kicker { color: #8a6300; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-chip { justify-self: start; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(12,114,82,.1); color: #0c7252; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Decision Receipt
components.description: An evidence-only receipt for immutable approval and measurement facts.
components.css: .ds-receipt { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--app-line-strong, rgba(23,23,20,.21)); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--app-surface, #fffdf9); color: var(--app-ink, #171714); font-family: var(--font-inter, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-receipt header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 12px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--app-line, rgba(23,23,20,.13)); } .ds-receipt header span { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-receipt header strong { padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(12,114,82,.1); color: #0c7252; font-size: 11px; } .ds-receipt dl { margin: 0; } .ds-receipt dl div { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 110px 1fr; gap: 12px; padding: 9px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--app-line, rgba(23,23,20,.13)); } .ds-receipt dl div:last-child { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-receipt dt { color: var(--app-muted, #65656f); font-size: 12px; } .ds-receipt dd { margin: 0; color: var(--app-ink, #171714); font: 500 12px/1.45 var(--font-jetbrains, ui-monospace, monospace); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
Joon is an operating surface for consequential retention work. It should feel watchful, exact and calm: a capable team has prepared the work, exposed the evidence and left the merchant in command. The interactive Joon application redesign reference is the visual and interaction authority. Warm canvas, ivory surfaces, dense ink, a navy navigation rail and decisive warm-gold actions establish the application world without competing with the task.

The system simplifies representation, never capability. Pages follow scan → work → prove: a concise summary, one principal workspace, then evidence in drawers, inspectors and receipts. Terminal language is reserved for evidence and decision receipts.
keyCharacteristics: Quiet, information-dense operational surfaces with obvious next actions.
Direct task navigation with Setup status, Settings and Ask Joon as utilities.
Semantic color with stable meaning: warm gold/action, blue/measurement, green/healthy status and red/failure.
Sans-serif language for operation; monospaced type only for data, measurements and receipts.
Two deliberate themes: warm paper, cobalt and the landing-page gold pair in light mode; near-black and amber in dark mode.

rules.name: The Stable Meaning Rule
rules.body: Warm gold asks for action, blue measures, green reports a truly healthy state or verified outcome and red reports failure. Never swap these roles to create visual variety.

rules.name: The Green Means Healthy Rule
rules.body: Green is evidence of health, successful completion or a verified positive result. Never use it as the general product accent.

rules.name: The Theme Pair Rule
rules.body: Light mode is warm canvas, warm paper, ink, navy and the landing-page gold pair; dark mode is near-black, pale ink and amber. Dark mode is a designed counterpart, not an inverted light palette.

rules.name: The Operation Before Instrumentation Rule
rules.body: Use sans-serif type for navigation, instructions, actions and prose. Use mono only when the content is data, measurement, an identifier or a decision receipt.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Founder-facing titles and controls use sentence case. Uppercase is a compact structural annotation, never the default voice.

rules.name: The Structure Carries Depth Rule
rules.body: Start with tone, spacing and border. Add shadow only when a surface must separate from its immediate context.

rules.name: The No Hover Lift Rule
rules.body: Operational cards remain spatially stable. Hover changes border or tone, not geometry.

dos: Do preserve every feature and route while simplifying how work is grouped and revealed.
Do organize pages around summary, workspace and receipt responsibilities.
Do make approval, suppression, holdouts, evidence strength and silence visually legible.
Do keep semantic color meanings stable in both themes and reinforce them with text or iconography.
Do keep the primary task, state, action and essential evidence usable at approximately 390px wide.
Do respect reduced motion and maintain WCAG 2.2 AA contrast and keyboard focus.
donts: Don't expose the internal feature taxonomy when a merchant task is the clearer label.
Don't use warm gold as generic decoration, blue as success, green as a general accent or pending action, or red as routine emphasis.
Don't spread terminal styling or monospaced prose across ordinary navigation, forms, cards or explanations.
Don't hide consequential scope, audience, suppression, schedule or measurement details behind decorative minimalism.
Don't add gradients, glass effects, glow or ornamental motion to compensate for weak hierarchy.
Don't let merchant-facing emails, storefront forms or brand assets inherit the Joon application theme.
